roles.g: The scalable extractor accepts only the frozen size and public constraint envelope and otherwise falls back.
roles.e: The public text is re-extracted into graph, forbidden-edge, exactly-one, objective, unit and quoted-evidence fields.
roles.t: The typed contract is compiled into the constrained TSP representation and scalable directed-MTZ backend.
roles.v: Candidate bytes are compared with a fresh public re-extraction and the returned tour/objective are independently decoded and checked.
roles.r: Input, candidate and model limits fail closed before execution; exact backend limits are enforced in the scalable path.
roles.p: Version strings, question hashes, code pins and the confirmation root closure record provenance, but no single skill manifest binds them as one object.

roles.g: A unique public error type and source LP/MIP class must be recognized; ambiguous evidence abstains.
roles.e: Public problem text, public MPS structure and a fresh solver IIS are converted into typed repair evidence.
roles.t: One of the finite repair-operation programs is applied through the inert six-operation DSL and MPS patcher.
roles.v: The candidate must be uniquely executable, and the frozen hidden endpoint checks status and repair consequences.
roles.r: MPS size, solver time, thread and execution constraints are enforced in runner/backend modules rather than embedded in each proposal object.
roles.p: Skill identifiers, schema, evidence-source declaration, source hashes, plan hashes and result hashes exist, but ancestry is distributed across plans and result artifacts.

components.K_t: The TSP and OR-Debug code closures are pinned by the mixed executor, but there is no canonical array of content-addressed skill manifests.
components.rho_t: The public-only exactly-one router is explicit and pinned.
components.V: Family-specific verifiers and resource checks are explicit and pinned, but their closure is not named by one verifier-manifest hash.
components.E: Frozen TSP and OR-Debug endpoint artifacts exist, but the library artifact does not bind their identities directly.
components.ledger_t: Accepted results, rejected traces, plans and root closures exist; there is no single parent-linked accepted/rejected version ledger.

required_closure: Define a canonical, answer-free skill-manifest schema that binds g/e/t/v/r/p by paths, hashes, versions and declared interfaces without embedding benchmark text or evaluator-only data.
Define a canonical library-manifest schema that binds K_t, rho_t, V, E, parent hash, rollback hash, promotion decision and accepted/rejected ledger references.

Reconstruct the current TSP plus OR-Debug library manifest from the already frozen artifacts and verify that running through the manifest reproduces the existing direct and mixed hashes without changing behavior.
Keep description length and empirical promotion results separate: manifest serialization supplies the code-length object, while held-out endpoints continue to determine utility.
Treat this audit as an implementation contract only; it does not authorize a refactor, rerun, new accuracy claim or automatic-acquisition claim.
